subject: maths
title: Simplifying Ratios
welcome_lead: Ratios compare parts. Learn to simplify them just like fractions to find their simplest form.
meta_desc: Learn to simplify ratios in this KS3 maths adventure with practice questions.
final_note: Brilliant work! Ratios are now tidy and tamed.

concepts.def: A comparison of two quantities, e.g. 2:3.
Reduce a ratio to its smallest whole numbers.
One of the quantities in a ratio.
Ratios with the same value, like 2:3 and 4:6.
Highest Common Factor: used to simplify ratios.
The symbol ':' used between parts of a ratio.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Simplify 12:18.

HCF of 12 and 18 is 6. Divide both by 6: 12÷6 = 2, 18÷6 = 3.

Simplified: 2:3.

Ratio 3:4 can be scaled up by multiplying both by the same number.

3:4 = 6:8 = 9:12 = 12:16.
